plan.question: Do actual Rawstep-projected inputs and announcements transfer to new nonmodal dialog tasks: named inner groups, returning to parent scopes, unnamed first-child groups, dynamic child counts, checkbox/toggle/disclosure changes and final save/submit outcomes?

plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.

Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.
